front_part.orientation: right-side/feet biased, connector axis tilted upward at least 45 degrees
front_part.support: limited organic support under connector and lower chin/feet only; block support on face and visible leaf/spines
front_part.removal: PASS_WITH_RESTPOINT: connector support is directly reachable from the open seam before assembly

back_part.orientation: rear shell supported with socket opening upward; avoid closing the blind socket over support
back_part.support: external organic support under lower rear leaves; no support inside the 10.30-mm socket
back_part.removal: PASS_WITH_RESTPOINT: all allowed support is external or reachable from the seam opening
